chondathan-freebooter.summary: Dodged Chondath’s mandatory soldiering by renouncing country and name and signing onto a ship, then spent years working the coasts of the Vilhon Reach, rich in local contacts.

dead-magic-dweller.summary: Fled to Anauroch’s dead magic zones, where spells and magical hunters falter, and came out tougher, wiser and skilled at desert healing and survival.

dragon-cultist.summary: Swore an oath to a hidden cell of the Cult of the Dragon, prizing deceit, secrecy and resolve in return for fellow worshipers and occult learning.

emerald-enclave-caretaker.summary: Serves the Emerald Enclave by tracking, foraging and reading the weather, keeping nature and civilization in balance and hunting unnatural threats.

flaming-fist-mercenary.summary: Once enforced the law in Baldur’s Gate with the Flaming Fist mercenary guild, learning to stare down trouble and take a beating, and upholds the guild’s hard reputation.

genie-touched.summary: A Calishite whose path crossed a genie’s, through a lamp, an oasis, a rescue or a bargain, leaving sharp senses, smooth speech and a trace of magic.

harper.summary: Took the Harpers’ oath to serve the common good, learning their melodies, passwords and sleight of hand to spy on and thwart evil.

ice-fisher.summary: Born to a long line of Ten-Towns ice fishers in Icewind Dale, hauling knucklehead trout from frozen lakes, a hard trade that hardened body and mind.

knight-of-the-gauntlet.summary: A holy warrior of the Order of the Gauntlet, scornful of evil, loyal to fellow knights and kind to war’s survivors, vowed to fight darkness across Faerûn.

lords-alliance-vassal.summary: Sworn to a Lords’ Alliance city, serving its lord’s honor and the Sword Coast’s safety, and trained equally in the blade and in statecraft.

moonwell-pilgrim.summary: A Moonshae Islander on a quest to visit every moonwell, gathering folk songs, painting landscapes and picking up some primal magic along the way.

mulhorandi-tomb-raider.summary: Raised on tales of Mulhorand’s buried riches under its god-kings, now delving into the land’s tombs and pyramids to recover its people’s relics.

mythalkeeper.summary: A Dalelands scholar, likely first drawn in by Myth Drannor’s ruins, who seeks out damaged or dormant mythals to study their lore and maybe mend one.

purple-dragon-squire.summary: Serves a Purple Dragon Knight of Cormyr as squire, learning the order’s ways and hoping to prove worthy of knighthood.

rashemi-wanderer.summary: Roamed Rashemen’s perilous windswept highlands, among fiend-binding obelisks, dragons and gnolls, and learned to keep strangers at arm’s length.

shadowmasters-exile.summary: Trained from youth for the Shadowmasters, the thieves’ guild secretly ruling Thesk, in stealth, speed and ruthlessness, until one mistake got you cast out.

spellfire-initiate.summary: Born with spellfire, the rare raw power of the Weave, and drilled in body and mind to bear its heavy cost.

zhentarim-mercenary.summary: Joined the Zhentarim mercenary network for money, belonging or results, and climbs its crooked, family-styled ranks with guile, quick reflexes and a blade.
